results.title: Kansas City city council approves $600 million commitment to build a new stadium for the Royals
results.description: The Kansas City Royals' quest to move to a new downtown ballpark cleared a major hurdle on Wednesday when the Kansas City city council approved a $600 million commitment to help make it happen.

results.title: Henderson sinks long putt for third straight birdie at CPKC Women’s Open
results.description: Watch as Brooke Henderson opens the back nine of her first round at the CPKC Women’s Open in Edmonton with three straight birdies, receiving positive energy from the home crowd.
